jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for a talented, skilled at analysis, strategic and highly organized professional with strong commercial acumen to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.

Your Impact

The objective of the role is to optimize DTC performance, identify and drive key levers, increase conversion rate to drive channel revenue, effectiveness and efficiency.
Optimize Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) performance by identifying and activating key growth levers that improve revenue generation across markets and Business-to-Consumer (B2C) sub-channels, conversion, channel effectiveness and operational and investment efficiency.

- Performance analysis: monitor and analyse performance against channel and commercial KPIs, providing channel-specific insights and recommendations by market to maximize revenue per B2C sub-channel (Web, Call Centre and Future Sales) and drive continuous improvement. Own the development, tracking and actioning of key KPIs.

- Drive efficiency, quantifying ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA by sub-channel by market to continuously optimize investments. Recommend reinvestments toward highest-impact channels.

- Develop attribution models to identify channel levers which drive revenue.

- Build and maintain B2C performance scorecards by market to monitor and optimize B2C channel performance, identifying drop-off points. Both on Excel and partnering with corporate team to make it available in self-serve tools (Power BI).

- Partner with Media, Digital, Commercial, Revenue, IT, Call Centre and Future Sales to improve customer journeys, reduce friction, increase conversion, repeat and customer lifetime value.

- Competitive analysis: monitor market conditions, competitive activity, and industry trends to support strategic planning and identify opportunities for differentiation and growth.

- Prepare executive-ready presentations, with clear data-based recommendations to support senior leadership strategic decision-making, leveraging stellar data visualization combined with depth of insights.

Your Journey so far

- 5+ years of prior experience in commercial analytics, business intelligence, DTC analytics or eCommerce performance.

- Preference for prior experience in the luxury hospitality/travel industry or consulting agencies.

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Commercial, or related field (Masters, MBA or equivalent experience preferred).

Your Essentials

- Proven experience supporting senior executives and thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment, managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.

- Highly Proficient in Excel and comfortable manipulating large datasets data and maintaining large spreadsheets with high level of accuracy

- Outstanding PowerPoint and storytelling skills — able to craft clean, crisp, high-impact presentations for C-suite audiences.

- Experience working with Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics or similar platforms, as well as BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.

- Knowledge of direct sales channels

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Fluent in English.

- Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever-evolving travel industry.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Dove la passione incontra l'opportunità

Scopri il tuo viaggio nello straordinario.

Il tuo scopo

Explora Journeys è un marchio di lusso europeo vibrante, cosmopolita, immaginato nel cuore dell'ospitalità svizzera a Ginevra. Sfruttando le centinaia di anni di esperienza marittima della nostra società madre MSC Group, la nostra flotta di sei navi di lusso (quattro attualmente in cantiere) sono state costruite e progettate in modo totalmente diverso e unico che trasformeranno e ridefiniranno l'esperienza di crociera, creando una categoria propria, attraendo la prossima generazione di viaggiatori di lusso.

Esiste un'opportunità entusiasmante per un talentuoso, esperto di analisi, un professionista strategico e altamente organizzato con un forte acume commerciale per unire il nostro nuovo marchio di viaggio di lusso Explora Journeys, con sede nei nostri uffici a Ginevra, in Svizzera.

Il tuo impatto

L'obiettivo del ruolo è quello di ottimizzare le prestazioni DTC, identificare e guidare le leve chiave, aumentare il tasso di conversione per guidare le entrate del canale, l'efficacia e l'efficienza.
Ottimizzare le prestazioni Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) identificando e attivando leve di crescita chiave che migliorano la generazione dei ricavi su mercati e sub-canale Business-to-Consumer (B2C), conversione, efficacia dei canali e efficienza operativa e di investimento.

- Analisi delle prestazioni: monitorare e analizzare le prestazioni contro i canali e i KPI commerciali, fornendo intuizioni e raccomandazioni specifiche del canale per il mercato per massimizzare i ricavi per il sub-canale B2C (Web, Call Centre e Future Sales) e guidare il miglioramento continuo. Possedere lo sviluppo, il monitoraggio e l'azione dei KPI chiave.

- Efficienza di trasmissione, quantificazione ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA da sottocanale da mercato per ottimizzare continuamente gli investimenti. Raccomanda reinvestimenti verso i canali più elevati di impatto.

- Sviluppare modelli di attribuzione per identificare leve del canale che guidano le entrate.

- Costruire e mantenere le schede di rendimento B2C per mercato per monitorare e ottimizzare le prestazioni del canale B2C, identificare i punti di drop-off. Sia in Excel che in collaborazione con il team aziendale per renderlo disponibile negli strumenti self-serve (Power BI).

- Partner con Media, Digital, Commerciale, Vendite, IT, Call Centre e Future Sales per migliorare i viaggi dei clienti, ridurre l'attrito, aumentare la conversione, ripetere e il valore della vita del cliente.

- Analisi competitiva: monitorare le condizioni di mercato, l'attività competitiva e le tendenze del settore per sostenere la pianificazione strategica e identificare le opportunità di differenziazione e crescita.

- Preparare presentazioni esecutive, con chiare raccomandazioni basate sui dati per supportare il processo decisionale strategico di leadership senior, sfruttando la visualizzazione dei dati stellari combinata con la profondità di insight.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- 5+ anni di esperienza precedente in analisi commerciali, intelligenza aziendale, analisi DTC o prestazioni di eCommerce.

- Preferenza per esperienza precedente nel settore dell'ospitalità di lusso / viaggio o agenzie di consulenza.

- Corso di laurea in Business, Economia, Finanza, Marketing, Commerciale o relativo campo (Master, MBA o equivalente esperienza preferita).

I tuoi essenziali

- Esperienza comprovata che supporta i dirigenti senior e prospera in un ambiente di avvio veloce, gestendo contemporaneamente più priorità.

- Eccellente analitica e problem solving competenze con la capacità di tradurre i dati complessi in insight aziendali attuabili.

- Eccellente in Excel e confortevole manipolazione di dati di grandi dimensioni e mantenimento di grandi fogli di calcolo con alto livello di precisione

- eccezionali competenze di PowerPoint e storytelling — in grado di creare presentazioni pulite, croccanti, ad alto impatto per il pubblico C-suite.

- Esperienza di lavoro con Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics o piattaforme simili, nonché strumenti BI e di visualizzazione come Tableau, Power BI, Looker o piattaforme simili.

- Conoscenza dei canali di vendita diretti

- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale. Fluente in inglese.

- Passione e curiosità per conoscere continuamente l'industria del viaggio in continua evoluzione.

A Explora Journeys, stiamo ridefinindo il viaggio oceanico di lusso - dove la scoperta, il benessere, e un profondo rispetto per i mari si uniscono in armonia.
Cerchiamo professionisti appassionati che condividono la nostra visione di un modo più coinvolgente e trasformativo per scoprire le destinazioni più ispiranti del mondo dal mare.
Sei pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a Explora Journeys, dove un oceano di opportunità attende. Il vostro viaggio verso lo Stato della Mente Oceano inizia qui.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Wo Leidenschaft auf Chance trifft

Entdecken Sie Ihre Reise ins Außergewöhnliche.

Dein Zweck

Explora Journeys ist eine lebendige, kosmopolitische, europäische Luxusmarke, die im Herzen der Schweizer Gastfreundschaft in Genf vorgestellt wird. Durch die Nutzung der hundertjährigen maritimen Expertise unserer Muttergesellschaft MSC Group wird unsere Flotte von sechs Luxusschiffen (vier derzeit in der Pipeline) auf eine völlig andere und einzigartige Weise gebaut und entworfen, die das Kreuzfahrterlebnis verändern und neu definieren und eine eigene Kategorie schaffen wird, die die nächste Generation von Luxusreisenden anspricht.

Eine aufregende Gelegenheit besteht für einen talentierten, fachkundigen, strategischen und hoch organisierten Fachmann mit starkem Geschäftssinn, sich unserer neu geschaffenen Luxusreisemarke Explora Journeys anzuschließen, die in unseren Büros in Genf, Schweiz, ansässig ist.

Ihre Wirkung

Das Ziel der Rolle ist es, die DTC-Leistung zu optimieren, Schlüsselhebel zu identifizieren und zu steuern, die Conversion-Rate zu erhöhen, um Kanaleinnahmen, Effektivität und Effizienz zu steigern.
Optimieren Sie die Direct-to-Consumer-Performance (DTC), indem Sie wichtige Wachstumshebel identifizieren und aktivieren, die die Umsatzgenerierung in allen Märkten und B2C-Subkanälen (Business-to-Consumer) sowie die Conversion-, Channel-Effektivität und die Betriebs- und Investitionseffizienz verbessern.

Leistungsanalyse: Überwachung und Analyse der Leistung anhand von Channel- und kommerziellen KPIs, Bereitstellung kanalspezifischer Erkenntnisse und Empfehlungen nach Markt, um den Umsatz pro B2C-Subkanal (Web, Call Center und Future Sales) zu maximieren und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voranzutreiben. Eigenständig für die Entwicklung, Verfolgung und Aktion von wichtigen KPIs.

- Steigerung der Effizienz, Quantifizierung von ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA nach Subkanal nach Markt, um die Investitionen kontinuierlich zu optimieren. Empfehlen sie reinvestitionen in kanäle mit höchster wirkung.

- Entwicklung von Attributionsmodellen, um Kanalhebel zu identifizieren, die den Umsatz steigern.

- Erstellen und Pflegen von B2C-Leistungs-Scorecards nach Markt, um die Leistung des B2C-Kanals zu überwachen und zu optimieren und Drop-Off-Punkte zu identifizieren. Sowohl auf Excel als auch in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Unternehmensteam, um es in Self-Service-Tools (Power BI) verfügbar zu machen.

- Partnerschaft mit Medien, Digital, Commercial, Revenue, IT, Call Center und Future Sales, um die Customer Journeys zu verbessern, Reibungen zu reduzieren, Conversion, Repeat und Customer Lifetime Value zu erhöhen.

Wettbewerbsanalyse: Marktbedingungen, Wettbewerbsaktivitäten und Branchentrends überwachen, um die strategische Planung zu unterstützen und Differenzierungs- und Wachstumsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren.

Bereiten Sie führungsbereite Präsentationen mit klaren datenbasierten Empfehlungen vor, um die strategische Entscheidungsfindung in der Führungsebene zu unterstützen, indem Sie die Visualisierung von stellaren Daten in Kombination mit tiefen Einblicken nutzen.

Deine Reise bisher

- 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in den Bereichen Commercial Analytics, Business Intelligence, DTC Analytics oder E-Commerce Performance.

- Präferenz für vorherige Erfahrungen in der Luxus-Hospitality / Reisebranche oder Beratungsagenturen.

- Bachelor-Abschluss in Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Commercial oder verwandten Bereichen (Masters, MBA oder gleichwertige Erfahrung bevorzugt).

Ihre Essentials

Bewährte Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von Führungskräften und in einer schnelllebigen Start-up-Umgebung, in der mehrere Prioritäten gleichzeitig verwaltet werden.

- Ausgezeichnete analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Daten in umsetzbare Geschäftserkenntnisse zu übersetzen.

- Sehr kompetent in Excel und bequemes Manipulieren großer Datensätze und Pflege großer Tabellenkalkulationen mit hoher Genauigkeit

- Hervorragende PowerPoint- und Storytelling-Fähigkeiten - in der Lage, saubere, klare und wirkungsvolle Präsentationen für das C-Suite-Publikum zu erstellen.

- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics oder ähnlichen Plattformen sowie BI- und Visualisierungstools wie Tableau, Power BI, Looker oder ähnlichen Plattformen.

- Kenntnis der Direktvertriebskanäle

- Hervorragende schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. fließend in Englisch.

- Leidenschaft und Neugier, sich ständig über die sich ständig weiterentwickelnde Reisebranche zu informieren.

Bei Explora Journeys definieren wir Luxus-Ozeanreisen neu - wo Entdeckung, Wohlbefinden und ein tiefer Respekt für die Meere in Harmonie zusammenkommen.
Wir suchen leidenschaftliche Profis, die unsere Vision von einer immersiveren, transformativeren Art und Weise teilen, die inspirierendsten Reiseziele der Welt auf dem Seeweg zu entdecken.
Bist du bereit, deine Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Begleiten Sie uns auf Explora Journeys, wo ein Ozean von Möglichkeiten wartet. Ihre Reise zum Ocean State of Mind beginnt hier.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Où la passion rencontre des opportunités

Découvrez votre voyage dans l'extraordinaire.

Votre but

Explora Journeys est une marque de luxe européenne dynamique et cosmopolite, imaginée au cœur de l'hospitalité suisse à Genève. Tirant parti de notre société mère MSC Group de centaines d'années d'expertise maritime, notre flotte de six navires de luxe (quatre actuellement dans le pipeline) sont en cours de construction et de conception d'une manière totalement différente et unique qui transformera et redéfinira l'expérience de croisière, créant une catégorie propre, attrayant pour la prochaine génération de voyageurs de luxe.

Une opportunité passionnante existe pour un professionnel talentueux, compétent en analyse, stratégique et hautement organisé avec une forte acuité commerciale pour rejoindre notre nouvelle marque de voyage de luxe Explora Journeys, basée dans nos bureaux à Genève, Suisse.

Votre impact

L'objectif du rôle est d'optimiser la performance du CIPH, d'identifier et de piloter les leviers clés, d'augmenter le taux de conversion pour stimuler les revenus, l'efficacité et l'efficience des canaux.
Optimiser la performance des entreprises à consommateurs en identifiant et en activant les principaux leviers de croissance qui améliorent la production de revenus sur les marchés et les sous-canaux d'affaires à consommateurs (B2C), la conversion, l'efficacité des canaux et l'efficience opérationnelle et d'investissement.

- Analyse des performances : surveiller et analyser les performances par rapport aux KPI de canaux et commerciaux, en fournissant des informations et des recommandations spécifiques de canaux par marché afin de maximiser les revenus par sous-canal de B2C (Web, Call Centre et Future Sales) et de stimuler l'amélioration continue. Posséder le développement, le suivi et l'action des principaux ICR.

- Conduire l'efficacité, quantifier ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA par sous-canal par marché pour optimiser continuellement les investissements. Recommander des réinvestissements vers des canaux à plus fort impact.

- Élaborer des modèles d'attribution pour identifier les leviers de canaux qui génèrent des recettes.

- Construisez et maintenez des fiches de performance B2C par marché pour surveiller et optimiser les performances des canaux B2C, en identifiant les points de chute. À la fois sur Excel et en partenariat avec l'équipe d'entreprise pour le rendre disponible dans des outils en libre-service (Power BI).

- Partenaire avec Media, Digital, Commercial, Revenu, IT, Call Centre et Future Sales afin d'améliorer les déplacements des clients, de réduire les frictions, d'augmenter la conversion, de répéter et la valeur de vie du client.

- Analyse concurrentielle : surveiller les conditions du marché, les activités concurrentielles et les tendances de l'industrie pour appuyer la planification stratégique et identifier les possibilités de différenciation et de croissance.

- Préparer des présentations prêtes pour les cadres supérieurs, avec des recommandations claires fondées sur des données pour appuyer la prise de décisions stratégiques des cadres supérieurs, en tirant parti de la visualisation des données stellaires combinée à la profondeur des idées.

Votre voyage jusqu'à présent

- 5 ans d'expérience en analyse commerciale, intelligence d'affaires, analyse DTC ou performance eCommerce.

- préférence pour l'expérience antérieure dans l'hôtellerie de luxe/l'industrie du voyage ou les agences de conseil.

- Baccalauréat en affaires, économie, finances, marketing, commercial ou domaine connexe (maîtrise, MBA ou expérience équivalente préférée).

Vos essentiels

- Expérience éprouvée pour soutenir les cadres supérieurs et prospérer dans un environnement de démarrage rapide, en gérant simultanément plusieurs priorités.

- Excellentes compétences d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes avec la capacité de traduire des données complexes en informations opérationnelles exploitables.

- Hautement compétent en Excel et confortable manipulant les données des grands ensembles de données et conservant de grands tableurs avec un haut niveau de précision

- Excellentes compétences en PowerPoint et en narration – capables d'élaborer des présentations propres, nettes et à impact élevé pour les auditoires C-suite.

- Expérience de travail avec Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics ou des plateformes similaires, ainsi que des outils BI et de visualisation tels que Tableau, Power BI, Looker ou des plateformes similaires.

- Connaissance des canaux de vente directe

- Excellente capacité de communication écrite et verbale. En anglais.

- Passion et curiosité d'apprendre continuellement l'industrie du voyage en constante évolution.

À Explora Journeys, nous redéfinissons le voyage maritime de luxe, où la découverte, le bien-être et le profond respect des mers s'unissent en harmonie.
Nous recherchons des professionnels passionnés qui partagent notre vision d'une façon plus immersive et transformatrice de découvrir les destinations les plus inspirantes du monde par la mer.
Êtes-vous prêt à transformer votre passion en quelque chose d'extraordinaire ? Rejoignez-nous à Explora Journeys, où un océan d'opportunités vous attend. Votre voyage vers l'état de l'océan commence ici.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Digital Analytics Strategy, Testing and CRO Manager will be responsible for driving D2C growth through data-driven experimentation and strategic optimization of our direct digital channels. You will spearhead our testing and insights strategy to maximize conversion rates, booking volumes and revenue per visitor, while building a best-in-class experimentation practice that delivers sustainable competitive advantage. This role will have a strong strategic focus on the direct channel, optimizing lead generation, and leveraging insights to drive higher customer acquisition, engagement, and lifetime value.

Your Impact

• Design and execute a comprehensive data driven strategy across all digital touchpoints, with particular focus on driving direct channel growth and reducing acquisition costs through improved conversion rates.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, engineering, marketing, and web analytics to conceptualize and design A/B tests that effectively measure the impact of website and campaign changes.

• Drive strategic initiatives within the direct channel, ensuring a data-driven approach to lead generation, audience segmentation, and customer journey optimization to improve conversion and engagement.

• Develop deep customer journey insights through advanced analytics, identifying key friction points and opportunities to enhance the user experience and drive higher booking values.

• Perform advanced digital segmentation analyses to uncover high-value customer segments and personalization opportunities across the conversion funnel.

• Establish robust measurement frameworks to quantify the commercial impact of optimization initiatives, including test design, revenue forecasting, and post-implementation analysis.

• Develop comprehensive performance dashboards that combine testing results, customer behavior metrics, and commercial KPIs to guide conversion rate optimization.

• Drive innovation in personalization and optimization strategies to maximize direct channel contribution using the newly adopted tools (Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Real-time CDP).

• Develop testing frameworks that balance quick wins with longer-term strategic initiatives.

Your Journey so far

• Degree in business, marketing, analytics, or a related field, with 5 years of relevant experience.

• Proven track record of leveraging D2C data insights to shape marketing and product strategies, particularly in booking funnel optimization.

• Hands-on experience with A/B testing tools like Adobe Target.

Your Essentials

• Expertise in web analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics and AEP.

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to distill complex data into actionable business strategies.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and influence decision-making.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, managing multiple initiatives simultaneously.

• EU Passport or right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

The SPA Product Manager is responsible for the strategic development, management, and optimization of spa products, treatments, and retail offerings. This role ensures that all spa products align with brand positioning, guest expectations, and commercial objectives, while driving revenue, innovation, and operational excellence across the spa portfolio.

Your Impact

- Define and execute the spa product strategy, including treatments, retail products, and wellness concepts, in line with brand standards and business goals

- Manage the full product lifecycle, from concept development and supplier selection to launch, performance  monitoring, and optimization

- Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Spa Operations, Marketing, Training, Procurement, Finance) to ensure seamless product implementation

- Lead supplier relationships, and performance reviews.

- Analyze product performance through KPIs, guest feedback, and financial results, and implement datadriven improvements

- Ensure all products comply with regulatory, safety, and brand standards across all locations.

- Support the development of pricing strategies, promotions, and revenue-driving initiatives.

- Work closely with Training teams to ensure therapists and staff are fully trained on products and treatments.

- Monitor market trends, and innovations within the spa and wellness industry to maintain a competitive offering.

- Support new openings, refurbishments, and special projects related to spa product development.

Your Journey so far

- Strong commercial and analytical mindset with proven experience in product performance management

- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills

- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

- Strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution

- Strong negotiation and supplier management skills

- High attention to detail with a focus on quality and guest experience

- Proven experience in spa, wellness, beauty, or hospitality product management

- Strong understanding of spa operations, treatments, and retail environments

- Experience working with premium or luxury brands preferre

- 10-15 years of experience in SPA and Wellness including Medispa treatments , retail products, and wellness concepts,

- Proven experience in managining the full product lifecycle, from concept development and supplier selection, legal requirements, launch, performance monitoring, and optimization.

- Excellent communication and leadership skills especially in guiding large teams and influencing stakeholders.

- Fluency in English is mandatory any other language is a plus.

- Strong leadership skills to oversee SPA operations across multiple locations.

- Experience with project management financial analysis and revenue management in the wellness or hospitality industry.

- Ability to work effectively with departments such as Marketing Guest Services and Revenue Management to create a cohesive wellness experience for guests.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

We are seeking a dynamic and highly motivated Mobile App Product Specialist to join our Business Innovation team at MSC Cruises Headquarters in Geneva. This role is designed for a data-driven professional with a strong commercial acumen, an analytical mindset, and a passion for optimizing mobile user journeys. The successful candidate will explore in-app behaviors, remove friction in the sales funnel, and drive product-led initiatives to maximize conversion rates and shape the future of digital guest experiences across the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

Your Impact

- Analyze the MSC for Me in-app user journey and behavior to identify bottlenecks, proposing and validating product initiatives that optimize the sales funnel and boost in-app conversion rates.

- Collaborate with Product, Tech, and UX/UI cross-functional teams to design and implement features that drive organic user acquisition and increase cross-selling/up-selling opportunities for the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Implement and optimize the in-app position of commercial offerings (working closing with Onboard Revenues Commercial Department) to maximize visibility and sales conversions specifically for mobile users.

- Use advanced product analytics tools and data visualization (Power BI) to track sales performance, user activation rates, and drop-offs into the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Act as a bridge between the Onboard Revenues Commercial department and the Tech/Development teams, translating revenue goals into clear digital product requirements to enhance the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Drive MSC for Me  channel-led acquisition by refining native in-app features—such as frictionless guest-to-registered user flows, invite-a-friend mechanisms, and seamless app sharing—to grow the user base.

- Conduct A/B testing on MSC for Me  in-app sales flows, checkout processes, and subscription models to continuously improve operational efficiency and revenue generation.

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Marketing Management, Digital or a related field.

- Strong commercial and analytical skills with 3 to 5 years of proven experience in digital sales, product growth, or digital business development, with a strict focus on mobile applications.

- Hands-on experience with app analytics, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), and data manipulation/visualization tools (Power BI, SQL; Python is a plus).

- Familiarity with agile methodologies and ability to work side-by-side with developers and product managers in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate data-driven insights into actionable business and product recommendations.

- Creative thinker with a proactive approach to problem-solving, capable of driving "Product-Led Growth" rather than relying on traditional marketing spend.

- Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.

Your Essentials

- Deep understanding of mobile user behavior, digital sales funnels, and product-centric acquisition ecosystems.

- Strong business acumen with a focus on maximizing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) and removing friction from the mobile buying experience.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outputs under tight deadlines.

VISA REQUIREMENTS (if any) :

- Right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo scopo

Siamo alla ricerca di un dinamico e altamente motivato Mobile App Product Specialist per unire il nostro team di Business Innovation presso la sede di MSC Crociere a Ginevra. Questo ruolo è progettato per un professionista guidato dai dati con un forte acume commerciale, una mentalità analitica e una passione per l'ottimizzazione dei viaggi degli utenti mobili. Il candidato di successo esplorerà i comportamenti in-app, rimuoverà l'attrito nell'imbuto di vendita e guiderà le iniziative orientate al prodotto per massimizzare i tassi di conversione e modellare il futuro delle esperienze degli ospiti digitali attraverso l'ecosistema digitale MSC for Me.

Il tuo impatto

- Analizzare il percorso e il comportamento dell'utente MSC per Me in-app per identificare i colli di bottiglia, proponendo e convalidando iniziative di prodotto che ottimizzano l'imbuto di vendita e aumentano i tassi di conversione in-app.

- Collaborare con i team interfunzionali di prodotto, tecnologia e UX/UI per progettare e implementare funzionalità che spingono l'acquisizione di utenti organici e aumentano le opportunità di cross-selling/up-selling per l'ecosistema digitale MSC for Me.

- Implementare e ottimizzare la posizione in-app delle offerte commerciali (chiusura di lavoro con Onboard Revenues Commercial Department) per massimizzare la visibilità e le conversioni di vendita specificamente per gli utenti mobili.

- Utilizza strumenti avanzati di analisi dei prodotti e visualizzazione dei dati (Power BI) per monitorare le prestazioni di vendita, i tassi di attivazione degli utenti e i drop-off nell'ecosistema digitale MSC for Me.

- Agire come ponte tra il dipartimento commerciale di Onboard Revenues e i team Tech/Development, traducendo obiettivi di fatturato in requisiti di prodotto digitali chiari per migliorare l'ecosistema digitale MSC per Me.

- Drive MSC for Me canale-led acquisizione raffinando caratteristiche native in-app, come ad esempio i flussi utente guest-to-registrati senza attrito, i meccanismi di invito-a-amico e la condivisione di app senza interruzioni—per aumentare la base utente.

- Condurre test A/B su MSC per Me flussi di vendita, processi di checkout e modelli di abbonamento per migliorare continuamente l'efficienza operativa e la generazione di ricavi.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- Laurea o master in Business Administration, Economia, Marketing Management, Digital o un campo relativo.

- Forte capacità commerciali e analitiche con 3-5 anni di comprovata esperienza nelle vendite digitali, nella crescita del prodotto o nello sviluppo di business digitale, con un focus rigoroso sulle applicazioni mobili.

- Esperienza pratica con analisi delle app, ottimizzazione del tasso di conversione (CRO) e strumenti di manipolazione/visualizzazione dei dati (Power BI, SQL; Python è un plus).

- Familiarità con metodologie agili e capacità di lavorare fianco a fianco con sviluppatori e product manager in ambienti dinamici e veloci.

- Eccellente capacitÃ di comunicazione e collaborazione, con la capacitÃ di tradurre intuizioni basate sui dati in raccomandazioni aziendali e di prodotto attuabili.

- Pensatore creativo con un approccio proattivo al problem-solving, capace di guidare "Product-Led Growth" piuttosto che affidarsi alla spesa di marketing tradizionale.

- Fluente in inglese; lingue europee aggiuntive sono un plus.

I tuoi essenziali

- Profonda comprensione del comportamento degli utenti mobili, imbuti di vendita digitali e ecosistemi di acquisizione orientati al prodotto.

- Forte business acumen con l'obiettivo di massimizzare il valore di vita del cliente (CLV) e rimuovere l'attrito dall'esperienza di acquisto mobile.

- Capacità di gestire più priorità e fornire uscite di alta qualità sotto scadenze strette.

REQUISITI VISA (se presenti) :

- Diritto di lavorare in Svizzera.

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

Do you excel at turning complexity into clarity? Are you energized by shaping ideas, challenging assumptions, and amplifying a leader’s impact?
We are seeking a New Builds Development & Delivery Manager who will act as an extension of the Senior Manager of Concept Innovation, enhancing strategic thinking, improving decision‑making speed, and helping bring robust, high-quality concepts to senior leadership.
This role is not operational and not a presentation-updating position. It is a partnership role, designed for someone who can think critically, structure ambiguous problems, challenge insights, and support the development of transformational guest experience concepts.You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across Experience, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, and Strategy, ensuring concepts are analytically sound, insight-driven, and aligned with the company expectations. You’ll gain exposure to strategic discussions, influence senior decision-making, and drive clarity across innovation workstreams.
If you are a sharp thinker, a natural challenger, and a trusted partner able to elevate the work of others, this is the role for you

Your Impact

Strategic Support & Thought Partnership

- Act as a direct strategic partner to the Senior Manager, helping structure thinking, frame problems, and sharpen concept narratives.

- Participate in or lead selected meetings on behalf of Guest Experience Innovation

- Prepare strategic briefs, decision frameworks, and synthesis documents for SVP-level conversations.

Narrative Building & Executive-Ready Communication

- Craft clear, concise, and strategically sound storytelling materials for leadership forums

- Transform complex information into high-impact narratives.

- Support leadership in preparing for SVP/EVP/Executive Committee discussions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Engage with Experience, Entertainment, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, Strategy, and Operations teams to gather insights and shape concepts.

- Lead the development and delivery of new entertainment concepts, experiences, and spaces across our fleet.

- Act as the key link between creative partners, operations, and corporate functions, ensuring alignment and buy-in at every stage.

Project & Stakeholder Management

- Drive clarity in workstreams by structuring timelines, identifying decision points, and anticipating risks.

- Follow up with stakeholders to ensure progress and alignment.

- Elevate issues early and propose mitigation scenarios.

Your Journey so far

- 5–8 years in strategy, innovation, business design, consulting, or strategic project management.

- Experience in hospitality, cruise, retail, consumer goods, or guest experience is a strong plus.

- Strong background in designing and executing guest-focused experiences, from concept to delivery.

- A balance of creativity and operational know-how, able to dream big and deliver practically.

- Proven track record in managing complex, cross-functional teams (operations, creative, marketing, sales, revenue, communications), with the ability to unite diverse perspectives around a single vision.

- Excellent knowledge of modern visual communication tools (Canva, Adobe Suite, AI-driven creative platforms) to produce compelling visual documents and storytelling assets beyond traditional slide decks.

Your Purpose

The Junior Architect supports the Port Development team through fast and accurate production of conceptual and technical drawings.
The role is focused on internal execution: transforming design inputs into conceptual documentation and effective visualizations to support decision-making across private destinations, cruise terminals, port infrastructure and related facilities.

Your Impact

- Support the translation of business and design inputs into zoning studies, basic spatial diagrams, and architectural layouts.

- Assist in the development of preliminary layouts following internal design guidance and operational requirements.

- Prepare early stage conceptual design packages for internal review and coordination.

- Produce presentation decks, diagrams, visual narratives, and material boards to support internal communication.

- Develop mandatory 3D models and real time visualizations to support internal reviews and executive level presentations.

- Rapidly update, correct, and revise architectural drawings, including plans, sections, elevations, layouts, façade studies, and circulation diagrams.

- Adapt and coordinate port and civil drawings, including site layouts, infrastructure interfaces, circulation roads, and hardscape coordination.

- Strong passion for architecture and the world of interiors, materials and spatial composition.

- Curious and design-oriented, with attention to proportion, atmosphere and detail.

- Execution-driven and highly operational.

- Fast in drawing production and revisions.

- Detail-oriented and structured.

- Comfortable working under tight timelines in a dynamic development environment.

Your Essentials

- Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD with strong drafting speed and precision.

- Strong 3D modeling capabilities in SketchUp or Revit (SketchUp preferred).

- Mandatory experience with real-time rendering tools (Enscape, Twinmotion or equivalent).

- Good knowledge of Photoshop for post-production and corrections.

- Basic knowledge of (or interest in) AI tools such as Stable Diffusion or Magnific AI.

- The ability to independently produce clear, standard-quality visualizations for internal decision-making.

- Portfolio including technical drawings and rendered visualizations to be shared with the CV.

- Aider à l'élaboration de plans préliminaires suivant les directives de conception interne et les exigences opérationnelles.

Votre voyage jusqu'à présent

- Une forte passion pour l'architecture et le monde des intérieurs, des matériaux et de la composition spatiale.

- Curieux et orienté vers la conception, avec attention à la proportion, l'atmosphère et le détail.

- Dirigé par l'exécution et hautement opérationnel.

- Production et révisions rapides du dessin.

- Orientation détaillée et structurée.

- Travail confortable dans un environnement de développement dynamique.

Vos essentiels

- Compétence avancée en AutoCAD avec une grande vitesse de rédaction et de précision.

- Fortes capacités de modélisation 3D dans SketchUp ou Revit (SketchUp préféré).

- Expérience obligatoire avec des outils de rendu en temps réel (Enscape, Twinmotion ou équivalent).

- Bonne connaissance de Photoshop pour la postproduction et les corrections.

- Connaissance de base (ou intérêt) des outils d'IA tels que la diffusion stable ou l'IA magnifique.

- La capacité de produire de manière indépendante des visualisations claires et de qualité standard pour la prise de décisions internes.

Une compétence professionnelle complète en anglais est requise; d'autres langues sont un avantage.

Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui valorise les diverses perspectives, embrasse le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être lui-même authentique. jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The F&B Service Manager is a strategic headquarters-based role responsible for providing leadership, oversight, and guidance for all Food & Beverage service operations across the fleet. This role ensures service excellence, consistency in guest experience, and alignment with corporate standards. Acting as the primary liaison between shipboard teams and corporate leadership, the Manager of F&B Service drives quality, innovation, compliance, and talent development across all F&B operations. This role reports directly to the Vice President of F&B.

Your Impact

Strategic Operations & Standards

- Define, implement, and maintain fleet-wide F&B service standards and best practices.

- Develop and oversee strategic initiatives to enhance guest experience and operational efficiency across all vessels.

- Coordinate with shipboard teams to ensure compliance with corporate policies, procedures, and brand standards.

- Conduct remote audits, operational reviews, and assessments to maintain service excellence.

Guest Experience & Quality Assurance

- Monitor guest satisfaction and F&B performance metrics, analyze trends, and recommend improvements.

- Collaborate with culinary and beverage teams to innovate and elevate the onboard F&B offering.

- Ensure alignment with global health, safety, and hygiene protocols through corporate-led programs.

Training & Leadership Development

- Design and oversee training programs for F&B teams to ensure consistency with the brand’s service philosophy.

- Mentor and develop shipboard F&B leaders to support career progression and succession planning.

Human Resources & Leadership Oversight

- Collaborate with HR on performance reviews, promotions, rotations, and career pathing for F&B personnel.

- Promote a high-performance culture rooted in recognition, development, and fairness.

Fleet Support & Headquarters Coordination

- Serve as the principal corporate liaison for all F&B service matters across the fleet.

- Coordinate F&B equipment planning, material sourcing, and integration of brand standards.

- Compile and analyze operational reports, voyage summaries, and performance metrics for corporate leadership.

- Participate in key shipboard meetings remotely or in person as required.

Financial Oversight

- Support financial sustainability and profitability of F&B operations across the fleet.

- Implement continuous improvement programs to achieve operational and financial targets.

- Oversee cost control, inventory planning, and resource allocation in coordination with shipboard teams.

Your Journey so far

- Minimum 15 years in high-end Food & Beverage operations.

- At least 5 years in senior leadership roles within luxury hospitality or cruise operations.

- Proven experience in multi-site operational oversight.

Your Essentials

Leadership & Communication

- Strategic, dynamic leader with experience managing multicultural teams.

- Excellent communication skills, fluent in English; additional languages an asset.

Technical & Operational Knowledge

- Proficient in Microsoft Office and industry-specific systems.

- Strong understanding of HR protocols, labor regulations, and compliance standards.

- Expert knowledge of F&B operations, beverage programming, and luxury hospitality standards.

Professional Competencies

- Strategic thinker with operational agility and strong business acumen.

- Results-driven, detail-oriented, and highly collaborative.

- Capable of working cross-functionally across corporate and shipboard teams.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Il tuo scopo

L'F&B Service Manager è un ruolo strategico di base responsabile per la gestione, la supervisione e la guida di tutte le operazioni di servizio Food & Beverage in tutta la flotta. Questo ruolo garantisce l'eccellenza del servizio, la coerenza nell'esperienza degli ospiti e l'allineamento con gli standard aziendali. Essendo il principale collegamento tra i team di bordo e la leadership aziendale, il Manager di F&B Service guida qualità, innovazione, conformità e sviluppo di talenti in tutte le operazioni F&B. Questo ruolo riporta direttamente al Vice Presidente della F&B.

Il tuo impatto

Operazioni e standard strategici

- Definire, implementare e mantenere standard di servizio F&B a livello di flotta e best practice.

- Sviluppare e supervisionare iniziative strategiche per migliorare l'esperienza degli ospiti e l'efficienza operativa in tutte le navi.

- Coordinare i team di bordo per garantire il rispetto delle politiche aziendali, delle procedure e degli standard di marca.

- Condurre audit remoti, recensioni operative e valutazioni per mantenere l'eccellenza dei servizi.

Esperienza e garanzia di qualità

- Monitorare la soddisfazione degli ospiti e le metriche delle prestazioni F&B, analizzare le tendenze e raccomandare miglioramenti.

- Collabora con i team culinari e bevande per innovare ed elevare l'offerta F&B a bordo.

- Assicurare l'allineamento con i protocolli di salute, sicurezza e igiene globali attraverso i programmi aziendali.

Sviluppo della formazione e della leadership

- Progettare e supervisionare i programmi di formazione per i team F&B per garantire la coerenza con la filosofia di servizio del marchio.

- Mentor e sviluppare i leader di bordo F&B per sostenere la progressione di carriera e la pianificazione di successione.

Risorse umane e supervisione della leadership

- Collaborare con le risorse umane su recensioni, promozioni, rotazioni e percorsi di carriera per il personale F&B.

- Promuovere una cultura ad alte prestazioni radicata nel riconoscimento, nello sviluppo e nell'equità.

Supporto flotta e coordinamento centrale

- Servire come principale collegamento aziendale per tutti i servizi F&B in tutta la flotta.

- Coordinate pianificazione delle attrezzature F&B, sourcing dei materiali e integrazione degli standard del marchio.

- Compili e analizza report operativi, riassunti di viaggio e metriche di performance per la leadership aziendale.

- Partecipare a riunioni chiave di bordo da remoto o di persona come richiesto.

Supervisione finanziaria

- Sostenere la sostenibilità finanziaria e la redditività delle operazioni F&B in tutta la flotta.

- Implementare programmi di miglioramento continuo per raggiungere obiettivi operativi e finanziari.

- supervisionare il controllo dei costi, la pianificazione dell'inventario e l'assegnazione delle risorse in coordinamento con i team di bordo.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- Minimo 15 anni in alta gamma Food & Beverage operazioni.

- Almeno 5 anni in ruoli di leadership senior all'interno di ospitalità di lusso o operazioni di crociera.

- Esperienza comprovata nella supervisione operativa multi-sito.

I tuoi essenziali

Leadership e comunicazione

- Leader strategico e dinamico con esperienza nella gestione di team multiculturali.

- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, fluente in inglese; lingue aggiuntive un bene.

Conoscenza tecnica e operativa

- Proficiente in Microsoft Office e sistemi specifici per il settore.

- Forte comprensione dei protocolli HR, dei regolamenti del lavoro e degli standard di conformità.

- Conoscenza esperta delle operazioni F&B, della programmazione delle bevande e degli standard di ospitalità di lusso.

Competenze professionali

- Pensatore strategico con agilità operativa e forte acume aziendale.

- Risultati guidati, orientati ai dettagli e altamente collaborativi.

Der F&B Service Manager ist eine strategische Zentrale, die für die Führung, Aufsicht und Anleitung für alle Food & Beverage Service-Operationen in der gesamten Flotte verantwortlich ist. Diese Rolle gewährleistet Service-Exzellenz, Konsistenz im Gästeerlebnis und die Ausrichtung auf Unternehmensstandards. Als primäre Verbindung zwischen den Schiffsteams und der Unternehmensführung fördert der Manager von F&B Service Qualität, Innovation, Compliance und Talententwicklung in allen F&B-Betrieben. Diese Rolle berichtet direkt an den Vizepräsidenten von F&B.

Ihre Wirkung

Strategische Operationen und Standards

Definieren, implementieren und pflegen Sie flottenweite F&B-Servicestandards und Best Practices.

- Entwicklung und Überwachung strategischer Initiativen zur Verbesserung des Gästeerlebnisses und der betrieblichen Effizienz auf allen Schiffen.

- Abstimmung mit Bordteams, um die Einhaltung von Unternehmensrichtlinien, -verfahren und Markenstandards sicherzustellen.

- Durchführung von Remote-Audits, operativen Überprüfungen und Bewertungen, um die Service-Exzellenz zu erhalten.

Guest Experience & Qualitätssicherung

- Überwachen Sie die Gästezufriedenheit und die Leistungskennzahlen von F&B, analysieren Sie Trends und empfehlen Sie Verbesserungen.

- Arbeiten Sie mit kulinarischen und Getränketeams zusammen, um das F & B-Angebot an Bord zu erneuern und zu verbessern.

Sicherstellung der Angleichung an globale Gesundheits-, Sicherheits- und Hygieneprotokolle durch unternehmensgeführte Programme.

Training & Leadership Entwicklung

Entwerfen und beaufsichtigen Sie Schulungsprogramme für F & B-Teams, um die Konsistenz mit der Servicephilosophie der Marke zu gewährleisten.

- Mentor und Entwicklung von F & B-Führungskräften an Bord, um die Karriereentwicklung und Nachfolgeplanung zu unterstützen.

Human Resources & Leadership Oversight

- Zusammenarbeit mit HR bei Leistungsbeurteilungen, Beförderungen, Rotationen und Karrierewegen für F & B-Personal.

Förderung einer Hochleistungskultur, die in Anerkennung, Entwicklung und Fairness verwurzelt ist.

- Koordinieren Sie die F&B-Ausrüstungsplanung, die Materialbeschaffung und die Integration von Markenstandards.

- Erstellung und Analyse von Betriebsberichten, Reisezusammenfassungen und Leistungskennzahlen für die Unternehmensführung.

- Nehmen Sie an wichtigen Bordbesprechungen aus der Ferne oder bei Bedarf persönlich teil.

- Unterstützung der finanziellen Nachhaltigkeit und Rentabilität von F & B-Operationen in der gesamten Flotte.

- Implementierung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungsprogramme zur Erreichung operativer und finanzieller Ziele.

- Überwachung der Kostenkontrolle, Bestandsplanung und Ressourcenzuweisung in Abstimmung mit den Schiffsteams.

Deine Reise bisher

- Mindestens 15 Jahre im High-End-Food & Beverage-Betrieb.

- Mindestens 5 Jahre in leitenden Führungspositionen im Bereich Luxus-Hospitality oder Kreuzfahrtbetrieb.

- Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der operativen Aufsicht über mehrere Standorte.

Ihre Essentials

Führung & Kommunikation

Strategische, dynamische Führungskraft mit Erfahrung im Management multikultureller Teams.

- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, fließend Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen ein Vorteil.

Technisches und operatives Wissen

- Proficient in Microsoft Office und branchenspezifischen Systemen.

- Starkes Verständnis von HR-Protokollen, Arbeitsvorschriften und Compliance-Standards.

Expertenwissen über F & B-Operationen, Getränkeprogrammierung und Luxus-Hospitality-Standards.

Berufliche Kompetenzen

- Strategischer Denker mit operativer Agilität und starkem Geschäftssinn.

jobs.title: Culinary Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Culinary Operations Manager provides strategic leadership and oversight for all culinary operations across the fleet. The Manager of Culinary Operations is a strategic role on the overall financial cost of the culinary department, monitoring and guiding the team, and actively participating in recruitment for leadership positions within the culinary function. Acting as the strategic link between the corporate office in Geneva and the traveling and shipboard teams, this role ensures consistent quality, compliance with corporate standards, and continuous culinary innovation. This role directly reports to the Vice President of F&B.

Your Impact

Strategic Culinary Leadership

- Provide visionary leadership and guidance for the culinary team across the fleet, ensuring alignment with brand philosophy.

- Define, implement, and uphold fleet-wide culinary operational standards and best practices.

- Play an active role in strategic planning for all F&B service and beverage needs.

- Lead menu development, recipe creation, and implementation of culinary projects.

Operational Oversight & Quality Assurance

- Conduct structured operational reviews, remote audits, and ship visits as required.

- Ensure food quality, presentation, and consistency across all vessels.

- Monitor guest satisfaction metrics and implement strategic improvements.

- Ensure compliance with global health, safety, and hygiene protocols.

- Oversee beverage order and loading coordination.

Training & Leadership Development

- Mentor and develop future culinary leaders and onboard chefs.

- Design and implement fleet-wide training programs in line with brand standards.

- Foster long-term succession planning for culinary leadership positions.

Human Resources & Team Management

- Drive a high-performance culture emphasizing recognition, development, and fairness.

- Oversee leadership performance reviews, promotions, and career pathing.

- Support HR in recruitment for senior culinary positions and host rotations.

Fleet Support & Headquarters Coordination

- Act as the principal liaison for all culinary matters between corporate headquarters and the fleet.

- Coordinate galley equipment planning, material sourcing, and integration of brand standards.

- Compile operational and financial reports for corporate leadership.

Financial Oversight

- Overseeing food orders and maintaining the food master list to ensure accuracy, proper order planning, and sequence management.

- Responsible for overall financial cost of the culinary department.

- Implement continuous improvement plans to meet or exceed economic targets.

- Oversee cost control, inventory optimization, and resource planning.

- Play a key role for the overall financial cost of the culinary department.

Your Journey so far

- Minimum 15 years in high-end culinary operations with advanced skills.

- At least 5 years in senior leadership roles within luxury hospitality or cruise operations.

- Proven experience in fleet-wide or multi-site culinary management.

Your Essentials

Leadership & Communication

- Dynamic, strategic leader with experience managing multicultural teams.

- Excellent communication skills, fluent in English; additional languages an asset.

Technical & Operational Knowledge

- Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and industry-specific systems.

- Knowledge of HR protocols, time and attendance compliance, and labor regulations.

- Expertise in culinary operations, menu development, and luxury hospitality standards.

Professional Competencies

- Strategic thinker with operational agility and strong business acumen.

- Highly detail-oriented, results-driven, and guest experience-focused.

- Strong collaborator capable of working cross-functionally across corporate and shipboard teams.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Il tuo scopo

Il Culinary Operations Manager fornisce leadership strategica e supervisione per tutte le operazioni culinarie in tutta la flotta. Il Direttore delle Operazioni Culinarie è un ruolo strategico sul costo finanziario complessivo del reparto culinario, il monitoraggio e la guida del team, e partecipa attivamente al reclutamento per le posizioni di leadership all'interno della funzione culinaria. Essendo il collegamento strategico tra l'ufficio aziendale di Ginevra e i team di viaggio e di bordo, questo ruolo garantisce una qualità costante, il rispetto degli standard aziendali e la continua innovazione culinaria. Questo ruolo riporta direttamente al Vice Presidente della F&B.

Il tuo impatto

Leadership culinaria strategica

- Fornire leadership visionaria e guida per il team culinario di tutta la flotta, garantendo l'allineamento con la filosofia del marchio.

- Definire, implementare e sostenere gli standard operativi e le migliori pratiche culinarie a livello della flotta.

- Gioca un ruolo attivo nella pianificazione strategica per tutte le esigenze di servizio e bevande F&B.

- Sviluppo del menu di piombo, creazione di ricette e realizzazione di progetti culinari.

Supervisione operativa e garanzia di qualità

- Condurre le revisioni operative strutturate, gli audit remoti e le visite delle navi come richiesto.

- Monitorare le metriche di soddisfazione degli ospiti e implementare miglioramenti strategici.

Sviluppo della formazione e della leadership

- Mentore e sviluppare futuri leader culinari e chef a bordo.

- Progettare e implementare programmi di formazione a livello di flotta in linea con gli standard di marca.

- Promuovere la pianificazione di successione a lungo termine per le posizioni di leadership culinaria.

Risorse umane e gestione del team

- Guidare una cultura ad alte prestazioni enfatizzando il riconoscimento, lo sviluppo e l'equità.

- Superare le recensioni delle prestazioni di leadership, le promozioni e il percorso di carriera.

- Supporto HR in reclutamento per posizioni culinarie senior e rotazione host.

Supporto flotta e coordinamento centrale

- Agire come principale collegamento per tutte le questioni culinarie tra il quartier generale aziendale e la flotta.

- Coordinate la pianificazione delle attrezzature galley, il sourcing dei materiali e l'integrazione degli standard del marchio.

- Compili rapporti operativi e finanziari per la leadership aziendale.

Supervisione finanziaria

- supervisionare gli ordini alimentari e mantenere l'elenco dei master alimentari per garantire accuratezza, pianificazione corretta dell'ordine e gestione delle sequenze.

- Responsabile del costo finanziario complessivo del reparto culinario.

- Implementare piani di miglioramento continuo per soddisfare o superare obiettivi economici.

- supervisionare il controllo dei costi, l'ottimizzazione dell'inventario e la pianificazione delle risorse.

- Gioca un ruolo chiave per il costo finanziario complessivo del dipartimento culinario.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- Minimo 15 anni in operazioni culinarie di fascia alta con competenze avanzate.

- Almeno 5 anni in ruoli di leadership senior all'interno di ospitalità di lusso o operazioni di crociera.

- Esperienza dimostrata nella gestione culinaria a livello di flotta o multi-sito.

I tuoi essenziali

Leadership e comunicazione

- Leader dinamico e strategico con esperienza nella gestione di team multiculturali.

- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, fluente in inglese; lingue aggiuntive un bene.

Conoscenza tecnica e operativa

- Proficiente in Microsoft Office Suite e sistemi specifici per il settore.

- La conoscenza dei protocolli HR, la conformità del tempo e della frequenza e le normative del lavoro.

- Competenza nelle operazioni culinarie, nello sviluppo dei menu e negli standard di ospitalità di lusso.

Competenze professionali

- Pensatore strategico con agilità operativa e forte acume aziendale.

- Altamente orientata ai dettagli, orientata ai risultati e orientata all'esperienza degli ospiti.

- Forte collaboratore in grado di lavorare trasversalmente in team aziendali e di bordo.

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Dein Zweck

Der Culinary Operations Manager bietet strategische Führung und Aufsicht für alle kulinarischen Operationen in der gesamten Flotte. Der Manager of Culinary Operations ist eine strategische Rolle bei den Gesamtkosten der kulinarischen Abteilung, überwacht und führt das Team und beteiligt sich aktiv an der Rekrutierung von Führungspositionen innerhalb der kulinarischen Funktion. Als strategisches Bindeglied zwischen dem Firmensitz in Genf und den Reise- und Schiffsteams sorgt diese Rolle für gleichbleibende Qualität, die Einhaltung der Unternehmensstandards und kontinuierliche kulinarische Innovationen. Diese Rolle berichtet direkt an den Vizepräsidenten von F&B.

Ihre Wirkung

Strategische kulinarische Führung

- Visionäre Führung und Anleitung für das kulinarische Team in der gesamten Flotte, um die Ausrichtung auf die Markenphilosophie sicherzustellen.

- Definieren, implementieren und pflegen Sie flottenweite kulinarische Betriebsstandards und Best Practices.

- Spielen Sie eine aktive Rolle bei der strategischen Planung für alle F & B-Service- und Getränkebedürfnisse.

- Führen Sie Menüentwicklung, Rezepterstellung und Umsetzung von kulinarischen Projekten.

Operational Oversight & Qualitätssicherung

- Durchführung strukturierter Betriebsüberprüfungen, Fernaudits und Schiffsbesichtigungen nach Bedarf.

- Sicherstellung der Lebensmittelqualität, -aufmachung und -konsistenz in allen Gefäßen.

- Überwachen Sie die Metriken für die Gästezufriedenheit und implementieren Sie strategische Verbesserungen.

Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der globalen Gesundheits-, Sicherheits- und Hygieneprotokolle.

Beaufsichtigen Sie die Getränkebestellung und die Ladekoordination.

Training & Leadership Entwicklung

- Mentor und entwickeln zukünftige kulinarische Führungskräfte und Bordköche.

- Konzipieren und implementieren Sie flottenweite Schulungsprogramme nach Markenstandards.

- Förderung der langfristigen Nachfolgeplanung für kulinarische Führungspositionen.

Personal & Teammanagement

- Eine Hochleistungskultur fördern, die Anerkennung, Entwicklung und Fairness betont.

Überwachen Sie die Leistungsbewertungen von Führungskräften, Beförderungen und Karrierepfade.

- Unterstützung des Personals bei der Rekrutierung für leitende kulinarische Positionen und Host-Rotationen.

Fleet Support & Headquarter Koordination

- Als Hauptverbindungsstelle für alle kulinarischen Angelegenheiten zwischen der Unternehmenszentrale und der Flotte fungieren.

Koordinieren Sie die Planung von Galeerenausrüstung, die Materialbeschaffung und die Integration von Markenstandards.

- Erstellung von Betriebs- und Finanzberichten für die Unternehmensführung.

Finanzielle Aufsicht

- Überwachung von Lebensmittelbestellungen und Pflege der Lebensmittelmasterliste, um Genauigkeit, ordnungsgemäße Auftragsplanung und Sequenzmanagement zu gewährleisten.

- Verantwortlich für die gesamten finanziellen Kosten der kulinarischen Abteilung.

Umsetzung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungspläne, um die wirtschaftlichen Ziele zu erreichen oder zu übertreffen.

Beaufsichtigen Sie Kostenkontrolle, Bestandsoptimierung und Ressourcenplanung.

- Spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle für die finanziellen Gesamtkosten der kulinarischen Abteilung.

Deine Reise bisher

- Mindestens 15 Jahre in hochwertigen kulinarischen Betrieben mit fortgeschrittenen Fähigkeiten.

- Mindestens 5 Jahre in leitenden Führungspositionen im Bereich Luxus-Hospitality oder Kreuzfahrtbetrieb.

- Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im flottenweiten oder multi-site kulinarischen Management.

Ihre Essentials

Führung & Kommunikation

- Dynamic, strategischer Leiter mit Erfahrung im Management multikultureller Teams.

- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, fließend Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen ein Vorteil.

Technisches und operatives Wissen

Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite und branchenspezifischen Systemen.

- Kenntnis der HR-Protokolle, der Einhaltung von Zeit und Anwesenheit sowie der Arbeitsvorschriften.

- Expertise in kulinarischen Operationen, Menüentwicklung und Luxus-Hospitality-Standards.

Berufliche Kompetenzen

- Strategischer Denker mit operativer Agilität und starkem Geschäftssinn.

- Sehr detailorientiert, ergebnisorientiert und gasterlebnisorientiert.

Starke Mitarbeiter, die in der Lage sind, funktionsübergreifend in Unternehmens- und Bordteams zu arbeiten.

Unser Engagement

Wir setzen uns für eine Zukunft ein, die verschiedene Perspektiven wertschätzt, die Welt über Grenzen hinaus umfasst und ein integratives Umfeld fördert, in dem sich jeder Mensch geschätzt, respektiert und befähigt fühlt, sein authentisches Selbst zu sein. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Maßnahmen, die sich langfristig positiv auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten auswirken.

Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Begleiten Sie uns auf MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten auf Sie warten. Bewerben sie sich noch heute, um teil eines globalen teams zu sein, das grenzen überschreitet und etwas bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!

En tant que lien stratégique entre le bureau de l'entreprise à Genève et les équipes de voyage et de bord, ce rôle assure une qualité cohérente, le respect des normes de l'entreprise et l'innovation culinaire continue. Ce rôle relève directement du vice-président de F&B.

Votre impact

Leadership culinaire stratégique

- Fournir un leadership visionnaire et des conseils à l'équipe culinaire de toute la flotte, en assurant l'alignement avec la philosophie de la marque.

- Définir, mettre en œuvre et respecter les normes et les meilleures pratiques d'exploitation culinaire à l'échelle de la flotte.

- Jouer un rôle actif dans la planification stratégique pour tous les besoins en services et boissons F&B.

- Développement de menus de plomb, création de recettes et réalisation de projets culinaires.

Surveillance opérationnelle et assurance de la qualité

- Effectuer des examens opérationnels structurés, des vérifications à distance et des visites de navires au besoin.

- Assurer la qualité, la présentation et la cohérence des aliments dans tous les vaisseaux.

- Surveiller les indicateurs de satisfaction des clients et mettre en oeuvre des améliorations stratégiques.

- Assurer le respect des protocoles mondiaux de santé, de sécurité et d'hygiène.

- Surveiller l'ordre des boissons et la coordination du chargement.

Formation et perfectionnement en leadership

- Mentor et développer de futurs chefs culinaires et chefs embarqués.

- Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des programmes de formation à l'échelle de la flotte conformément aux normes de la marque.

- Favoriser la planification à long terme de la relève pour les postes de direction culinaire.

Ressources humaines et gestion d'équipe

- Conduire une culture de haute performance mettant l'accent sur la reconnaissance, le développement et l'équité.

- Surveiller les examens de rendement en leadership, les promotions et le cheminement de carrière.

- Soutenir les ressources humaines dans le recrutement de postes culinaires de haut niveau et la rotation des hôtes.

Soutien de la flotte et coordination du quartier général

- Agir comme principale liaison pour toutes les questions culinaires entre le siège social et la flotte.

- Coordonner la planification des équipements de cuisine, l'approvisionnement en matériaux et l'intégration des normes de marque.

- Compiler des rapports opérationnels et financiers pour le leadership de l'entreprise.

Contrôle financier

- Surveiller les commandes d'aliments et tenir la liste des aliments maîtres pour assurer l'exactitude, la bonne planification des commandes et la gestion des séquences.

- Responsable du coût financier global du service culinaire.

- Mettre en œuvre des plans d'amélioration continue pour atteindre ou dépasser les objectifs économiques.

- Superviser le contrôle des coûts, l'optimisation des stocks et la planification des ressources.

- Jouer un rôle clé pour le coût financier global du département culinaire.

Votre voyage jusqu'à présent

- Au moins 15 ans dans des opérations culinaires haut de gamme avec des compétences avancées.

- Au moins 5 ans à des postes de direction dans l'hôtellerie de luxe ou les opérations de croisière.

- Expérience éprouvée en gestion culinaire à l'échelle de la flotte ou de plusieurs sites.

Vos essentiels

Leadership et communication

- Leader dynamique et stratégique avec expérience dans la gestion d'équipes multiculturelles.

- Excellentes compétences en communication, maîtrise de l'anglais; langues supplémentaires un atout.

Connaissances techniques et opérationnelles

- Compétence en Microsoft Office Suite et systèmes spécifiques à l'industrie.

- Connaissance des protocoles de RH, du temps et de la fréquentation, et des règlements du travail.

- Expertise en opérations culinaires, développement de menus et normes d'hospitalité de luxe.

Compétence professionnelle

- Un penseur stratégique avec une agilité opérationnelle et un sens des affaires.

- Très axé sur les détails, les résultats et l'expérience des invités.

- Collaborateur fort capable de travailler interfonctionnellement entre les équipes d'entreprise et de bord.

Notre engagement

Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui valorise les diverses perspectives, embrasse le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être lui-même authentique. Notre engagement s'étend à prendre des mesures significatives et mesurables qui ont un impact positif à long terme sur nos invités, nos employés et notre planète.

Prêt à transformer votre passion en quelque chose d'extraordinaire ? Rejoignez-nous au MSC Cruises, où de nouvelles opportunités attendent. Appliquer aujourd'hui pour faire partie d'une équipe mondiale qui repousse les frontières et réalise quelque chose de remarquable. Votre voyage commence ici !

jobs.title: Digital Platforms Manager
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.An exciting opportunity exists for a talented Digital Professional to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys. This role is based in the office in Geneva.The Digital Platforms Manager will lead the strategy, development and deployment of our travel App.

Your Impact

The Digital platforms Manager will:

- Lead the strategy of the EJ guest Area including My Explora and our travel App

- Design and lead the development of the new App

- Define and maintain the Guest Area strategy and roadmap aligned with business goals.

- Establish governance frameworks, standards, and best practices for platform management.

- Identify opportunities for platforms innovation, optimization, and new capabilities.

- Document product features and create user stories

- Lead the creation and maintenance of platforms roadmap

- Translate complex technical requirements into actionable product specifications

- Communicate with cross-functional teams, including developers, designers, and business stakeholders

- Support the testing and release processes for new product updates

- Spot, report and follow the resolution & correction of bugs

- Monitor product performance metrics and making data-driven decisions

- Define KPIs and dashboards to track platform success.

Your Journey so far

- You have minimum of 8/10 years’ experience in a similar Role preferably in the Luxury or Luxury Hospitality/Travel Industry

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Digital Marketing, or related field.

- Experience managing web platforms, mobile apps, or enterprise digital ecosystems.

Your Essentials

- You set yourself apart through your personal accountability to deliver with excellence

- You are structured, well organized and know how to navigate in a matrix organisation

- Strong knowledge on the Digital projects lifecycle, particularly on complex or highly technical products

- You are a fast learner and tech savvy

- Knowledge in Adobe Experience Manager is a plus

- Fluent in English

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.
